channel.title: rhinegold Insights
channel.description: Practitioner-level analysis on semantic intelligence, AI search, and what B2B brands need to do differently — by rhinegold.

item.title: Content Architecture for LLM Authority
item.description: Four episodes diagnosed the new reality of AI search. The fifth turns to construction: how to architect content so LLMs treat your brand as a primary source — not an afterthought.

item.title: How to Measure What You Can't See
item.description: GEO metrics for the B2B practitioner: when buyers research through ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini before ever visiting your site, standard analytics are blind. Here's what to measure instead.

item.title: The Invisible Buyer Journey
item.description: Your prospect compared you to three competitors and read six LLM summaries before ever visiting your site. You saw none of it. That's the new buyer journey.

item.title: Why Your Analytics Stack Is Measuring the Wrong Layer
item.description: Keywords, rankings and clicks tell you where you appeared — not what the market actually heard. Why your current analytics stack is measuring the wrong layer.

item.title: The Two-Year Window and Why Most Teams Will Miss It
item.description: A 12–24 month lead in semantic intelligence doesn't give a proportional advantage — it compounds into structural market position. Most teams won't move in time.
